messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: feldspar-prod (priority: P1) — dedicated pool 'feldspar-feldspar-prod' GPU utilization 98% for 6m, token queueing high, error rate rising. page: oncall-ml, eng-infra, cs. 

alex_oncall: ack. jumping in. any impact to customer SLA?

priya_cs: Feldspar reported latency spikes from their app, they see 503s intermittently. Contact: dana@feldspar.com (on call).

maya_infra: looking at pool metrics now. autoscaler has min=8 max=64, current nodes=32, pods pending due to quota on the cluster side (quota for this VPC was hit).

dan_sre: confirmed GPU pods Pending -> "insufficient quota" on nodes. Not a runtime OOM on model processes.

liam_runtime: model-serving queues show long tokenize-to-first-byte latencies. Suggest immediate fallback to lower-memory model variant while we resolve capacity. Can we shift traffic to 'rw-small-v1' for low-priority routes?

alex_oncall: we need to avoid rolling customer traffic blindly. Priya, can Feldspar accept degraded model temporarily?

priya_cs: Dana says they can tolerate quality drop for 10-15 mins if it stabilizes production. Approving temporary fallback. I'll message them.

maya_infra: ops policy: autoscaler is blocked by VPC quota of GPUs (limit 32). We need manual increase from infra-ops or evict other tenants. This is single-tenant VPC, so eviction not allowed. Requesting quota bump.

ops-bot: /request-quota-increase project=feldspar-prod resource=gpu count=16 reason="Emergency scaling for P1 incident" — ticket #INC-205432-QR created, assigned to infra-ops. ETA 25m.

dan_sre: 25m is too long. Alternative: enable temporary burst to hosted spare pool? Querying cross-region fallback options.

liam_runtime: we can route a % of traffic to hosted 'rw-small-v1' or 'rw-medium-q4' on Redwood-hosted to absorb tail load. Recommend 60% to hosted small, 40% keep on dedicated for critical low-latency calls. Will prepare routing change.

alex_oncall: do it. Execute gradual ramp, monitor per-token cost. Post the exact commands.

liam_runtime: applying traffic-split now: 
```
redwood route update --tenant feldspar --route api/v1/generate --split "dedicated:0.4,hosted:0.6" --model-fallback rw-small-v1
```

liam_runtime: ramping to 60% hosted over 90s. watch metrics.

maya_infra: infra-ops just pushed a temporary quota bump to 48 GPUs (manual override). Nodegroup scaling started, new nodes expected in 4m.

dan_sre: good. when nodes join we should drain the hosted fallback back to dedicated. Let's keep routing for at least 2m after node ready to absorb.

alex_oncall: logging timeline and decision for postmortem. Priya, pls notify Feldspar that we enabled temporary model fallback and requested quota bump; they may see slightly lower quality.

priya_cs: DM sent to Dana, they replied :thumbsup: and asked for ETA. I gave ~6-8m for full recovery.

ops-bot: quota increase ticket updated: approved by infra-ops lead. 

maya_infra: nodes are up. kube status: 16 new GPU nodes ready. Autoscaler now at 48 GPUs, pod backlog cleared.

liam_runtime: reverting traffic split back to dedicated: 
```
redwood route update --tenant feldspar --route api/v1/generate --split "dedicated:1.0" --remove-fallback rw-small-v1
```

liam_runtime: rollback applied. observed latency and error rate trending back to normal.

alex_oncall: incident-> mitigation successful. Will create incident ticket INC-205432 for follow-up: root cause (VPC GPU quota + rapid traffic spike), action items: automate quota alerts, faster on-call bump flow, and test fallback playbook.

priya_cs: Feldspar confirmed recovery and appreciates quick response. Asked for a postmortem meeting with their infra lead tomorrow.

dan_sre: leaving notes for postmortem: check burst policy for single-tenant VPCs, ensure a healthcheck route for planned fallback, verify cost controls for hosted fallback.

alex_oncall: handing off to day team. oncall-out. :white_check_mark:
